item_verdicts.done_when: The done_when requires two logs naming revision/host/command, proving reckon.__file__ under each arm's own checkout, carrying pytest's summary line and ending EXIT=, with added ids derived by reckon.crew.review.added_failures_from_gate_logs; both arm logs carry all of these and the manifest's tests line records both summary lines.

justifications.durability: the node adds no test and its instrument population-job.sh lives only under the run directory with no committed guard, so a re-run can silently regress — the empty-target candidate arm of job 1288107 was caught by hand, not by a check.

justifications.fit: no source is added and the run artefacts (population-job.sh, arm logs, report.md) carry no plan label, version suffix or ticket id.
justifications.goal_fidelity: base-arm.log and candidate-arm.log show the population run to its summary line at both revisions, answering the brief's question as population-summary.txt records (196/197 files, added_count=0).
justifications.reuse: the node adds no definition and derives the added set through reckon.crew.review.added_failures_from_gate_logs (reckon/crew/review.py:2100) rather than hand-diffing FAILED lines.
